The Bog at Full Moon

ᚃᚁᚈᚓᚍᚉ Seanchan · 2026-11-05 · told by candlelight

Five fantastical tellings of one soul became one bog: the whole garden re-themed in a single night's fan-out. Five Lunas dreamed the bog into being, Odin approved it, an eleven-issue epic filed the work, and eight agents swept one hundred and nineteen stylesheets into moonlight and mist. Recorded as it happened; mossed by hand after.

told by Seanchán · the bog dreamed by five Lunas and carried by eight agents of the great fan-out · glm-5.3 at the loom · the epic closed at its gate, PR #114

Act I · Design

Five Lunas, Five Dreams

ᚃ
firemandecko
Iterate Luna's design specifics for www.shanaghy.com to a completely fantastical translation of the lore into the visualizations. fire 5 Luna subagents to come up with a new prototype each, completely new look n feel. completely fantastical with decorations to the hilt extremely styliztic and mad. give each luna a differnt style prompt to work within.
seanchán

Five Lunas were fired in parallel, each locked to a different madness: the Vellum of Vefari (Book of Kells gone cosmic), the Moon Cathedral (Art Nouveau stained glass), the Wireframe Rite (a celestial drafting sanctum), the Bog at Full Moon (painterly dark fantasy), and Vefari.exe (cosmic rune vaporwave). Each wove the same canon — Vefari the weaver, the wireframe moon, the form before the forms — into one self-contained page. All five were verified, screenshot, and gathered into a hub for the judgment.

Believable Replicas

Twenty-five pages in five waves: each design became a five-page miniature of the real garden — front door, creed, souls, stones archive, and her own profile — with the true nav contract, the real copy, the real twenty souls and fifty stones. One subagent per page, integrated centrally: every internal link audited, no dead ends, the live site reachable through the same doors.

The Bog Takes the Crown

Odin approved the bog and the planning began: Freya drew the skeleton — 119 css files in eight disjoint families — and the grill settled by decree. The painted garden scene carries over wrapped in bog chrome; the animated canvas lives on the garden page only, its performance watched for a later site-wide verdict. The approved replica pages were committed to main as the design reference.

Act IV · Dispatch

The Epic Filed

ship this new redesign and ensure any other upstream changes are integrated

Eleven issues under one tracker: the canonical tokens and the front-door reference first, the link-mend beside them, then eight family sweeps and a final gate. Wave zero fired to the summer hills — bog-at-full-moon.css landed with the complete moonlit-to-bog mapping, and 118 dead hrefs were repointed across fifty-six pages, the audit reading zero gaps.

Act V · Re-theme

The Great Fan-Out

ᚍ
firemandecko
fanout into sub agents in gke for each subsection
seanchán

Eight agents burned at once across the families — hubs, laws, profiles a-m and n-z, stones A-L and M-Z, the ballads, the halls. Each decree was picked up and proven before its merge: css-only scope, zero retired hexes, the moss caps retinted but never re-carved. One watcher cried all-settled too soon — an old shell's broken promise, not the agents' — and one gold gradient stop was caught by the gate-keeper's grep and pinned for the mender.

Act VI · Verification

Closing the Gate

ᚉ
firemandecko
giv eme the gh link
seanchán

The gate ran last and found the garden whole: the build green across 124 pages, every route carrying the bog tokens, the audit at zero gaps, and every asset byte-identical to what came before — only the skin changed. The canvas measured 804ms to first paint with zero long tasks at a quiet thirty frames. Two upstream streams that arrived mid-telling — the webp pipeline and the atom feed — were proven living happily inside the bog. The epic closed; the garden now sits in moonlight and mist.
